scope: Aggregate-only PRTI-GH dense cluster-count study; ML excluded
status: prospective project protocol, not a paper-reported experiment

requirements: same k, C, lambda, population, iterations, seed and PSO coefficient

selection_rule: Among configurations passing every privacy and feasibility rule across every comparison seed, select the lowest mean information loss. Break exact ties by lower maximum homogeneity fraction, then by the smaller cluster count.
release_boundary: Selection produces an aggregate research candidate only. It does not approve patient-level or unrestricted release; direct-identifier, free-text, custodian, and independent disclosure-control review remain.
